description: This Java source file defines an immutable logger class 'ImmutableDittoLogger' that implements thread-safe logging with MDC (Mapped Diagnostic Context) support, wrapping SLF4J Logger instances and managing MDC entries for contextual logging.

classes.name: ImmutableDittoLogger
